summary: Applicant's view of a TTAB opposition to an ITU application, from day 120 of the opposition period: standstill vs refuse vs abandon vs fight, against a self-interested opposer.
notes: PLACEHOLDER inputs (teaching estimates): rebrand_cost 100,000, opposer_stake 50,000 (what winning is worth to the opposer), cost_share 30,000 (opposer contribution in a rebrand settlement), rates 500/500, p_merits 0.60 (opposer wins on the merits if tried to decision), s18_shift 0.10 (merits mass moved by a Section 18 counterclaim), deal_mult 1.0, sfail_mult 0.5 (in-proceeding deal odds halve if standstill talks already failed). Payoffs are relative to 'keep the mark and get the registration' = 0; the utility reads terminal attrs rb/fx/sh and opponent_objective reads sw/sfx. The opposer's own costs come from edge attrs opp_hours/opp_fees via the shadowed opponent_dollars metric. Replace every param with the matter's own numbers. tornado/sweep/voi/posterior ignore opponent_objective (they assume a worst-case opposer), so use explicit solves for opposer-stake sensitivity.

scenario.probability_fn: tag("deal") ? p * (deal_mult * (tag("inproc") * flag("sfail") * (sfail_mult - 1) + 1)) : (tag("no-deal") ? 1 - (1 - p) * (deal_mult * (tag("inproc") * flag("sfail") * (sfail_mult - 1) + 1)) : (tag("cancel") ? (tag("merits-opposer") ? p_merits : 1 - p_merits) : (tag("merits-opposer") ? p_merits - flag("s18") * s18_shift : (tag("merits-applicant") ? (1 - p_merits) * 0.85 + flag("s18") * s18_shift * 0.8 : (tag("restrict") ? (1 - p_merits) * 0.15 + flag("s18") * s18_shift * 0.2 : p)))))
